programme.desc: A news bulletin announces that the BBA has been bought and transformed into a new, professional league, named the BEGA League and that Mr. Dickenson has resigned from his position as Chairman. The kids go off in search of their old friend and demand an explanation. Ashamed, Mr. Dickenson reveals that the board of the BBA had completed the plans to sell the league while he was occupied with the World Championships. Tyson resolves to show up at the press conference the next day and discover who is behind the plot. But at the press conference, he is faced with the new singing sensation, Ming-Ming who announces that not only is she the official mascot of the BEGA League but also its top ranked professional Beyblader. Tyson challenges her to Beybattle and Ming-Ming accepts under the condition that Tyson beat her entire Ming-Ming Band. Will Tyson, Max and Daichi be able to beat the Beybattling band and face off against an old foe?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max, Kenny and Daichi are invited by Boris to take a tour inside his new BEGA headquarters. Hilary isn't allowed inside until the official public opening, and is sent away, much to her chagrin. The boys find that the BEGA building is unparalleled in the quality of its Beyblade training and facilities. Impressive as it is however, Tyson is still highly distrustful of Boris, who was responsible for trying to take over the world two years ago by using his team the Demolition Boys as soldiers. Boris tries to convince Tyson that he's changed. Ever since his scheme was uncovered, he roamed throughout his homeland doing some soul searching. There, while watching some village children Beyblade, he had an epiphany. He realized that Beyblading is all about honor and individuality, and he made it his new goal to bring Beyblading to the masses. That's why he took over the BBA and turned it into BEGA ' as a way to give children around the world that had no exposure to the game a chance to better their lives and become champions themselves. Tyson is still skeptical, and his bad-mouthing of Boris draws the ire of a top BEGA prospect ' a juggernaut named Crusher, whose Beyblade launcher is the biggest one the boys have ever seen. When grilled by Tyson about his motives for joining this professional league, Crusher admits he's doing it for the prospect of getting rich, but only so he can afford to pay his younger sister's hospital bills. A Beybattle ensues, and Crusher shows he's even more powerful than he looks. Tyson is nearly defeated, but he summons his will and narrowly defeats his jumbo-sized opponent. When Boris asks Tyson if he now believes he's sincere in his reasons for creating BEGA, Tyson still isn't sure. But Tyson does admit that if spirited and honorable Blader's like Crusher are in it, maybe there is some merit in the new league after all.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger wanders the woods of White Tiger Hills, the headquarters of the White Tiger X team, and although this strange young man performs incredible good deeds, Lee and the rest of the team are suspicious, and tell their leader Ray, all about him. It isn't long until the entire team meets up with him again, and Ray comes face to face with the stranger's incredible abilities like leaping, flying and jumping through the air, not to mention Beyblading like a world champion. He calls himself Mystel and amazes Lee and Ray with the mixture of his incredible acrobatics and Beyblading skills. Lee imagines how good the White Tiger X team would be if they knew how to move like Mystel, and, after challenging their new guest to a battle, has high hopes that he'll share his secrets. But Lee is humiliated by a quick loss, and now it's up to Ray to represent the team in it's own backyard! Can he beat Mystel, and more importantly, can he find out the secrets behind this mysterious young Beyblader?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson can't seem to make up his mind whether or not to trust Boris and go pro. When the team is visited by a rabid pack of sponsors who want to sign them to product contracts, Grandpa is forced to step in and recommend that Tyson have a talk with his more experienced brother, Hiro. While looking for Hiro, Tyson and friends come across Tala, Bryan and Spencer, who are on their way to get revenge on Boris by bringing the BEGA league down around him. Tyson is torn between following Tala, and respecting Tala's wish that he stay out of it.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: An intense battle is played out on the stadium floor, when, it looks like Tala is about to lose, bars rise up out of the floor and keep him in the dish. As they continue to battle, Tala becomes weaker and weaker and collapses. Tyson's had enough. He yells out at Boris telling him his whole BEGA outfit is bogus and he challenges the shadowy figure to a battle. Boris accepts the challenges and at stake is the future of the BEGA and Tyson's future as a Beyblader!! Most of Tyson's friends surround him in a show of support, except one. Kai walks out of the stands and walks right by Tyson leaving him high and dry!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In response to Tyson's challenge of a one on one battle against the best Blader in BEGA, Boris counters by suggesting a five on five match. Tyson wants to accept but the odds are stacked against him. Kai has now joined the BEGA Blader's and BEGA now virtually controls the whole sport because they have set up an I.D. registration service for all Blader's who want to become professionals. Worst of all, Hiro, Tyson's brother has been hired on to coach the BEGA Blader's! Tyson tells his troubles to Ray but gets no sympathy. Secretly Ray has always wanted to battle Tyson when he was at his championship best so he challenges his old friend. An intense battle ensues with Tyson eventually coming out the winner. Ray is satisfied but his blade and Tyson's is ruined. With no hope of getting replacement parts the team decides to build their own blades and go face the BEGA Blader's in battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Hiro stuns the world by joining the BEGA League and coaching Brooklyn, their secret weapon. As the popularity of the new league rises, BBA Revolution find themselves unable to practice because Boris has cornered the market on new parts. Boris is satisfied with the progress of his top Blader's, who are training heavily in a series of practice and exhibition matches. Ming Ming and the rest of her teammates easily dispatch the competition.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. These former foes don't like Boris and his professional BEGA league either, seeing this new entity as a threat to the sport of Beyblading. They vow to help Tyson and the other members of the BBA Revolution in whatever way they can to overthrow BEGA.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they once came across, that they realize the secret of reining in their new spinners'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max and Ray struggle to learn the 'Hard Metal' system with the help of some of their friends from the World Championship tournament. They still need one more member for the team, and Rick, Lee and Michael have all volunteered to fill the remaining slot. But first they have to prove they can master the new system'which proves a lot tougher than they thought.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bega Bladers have one more Blader to pick for the BEGA 5 Justice Tournament and it's between the up and coming Brooklyn and Kai. As their elimination battle begins, Kai tries his best to take command but it seems Brooklyn mirrors his every move. Kai realizes something's fishy, but before he can do anything about it, Brooklyn takes the win, much to Boris's liking.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the start of 'Justice 5' and Daichi is set to battle Ming Ming, the crowd favorite because of her cute demeanor and sensational singing voice. Daichi's goal is to prove that Ming Ming doesn't take Beyblading seriously and he vows to knock her out of the stadium early in the match. However, when Ming Ming gains the upper hand this makes Daichi very annoyed. Worst of all, Ming Ming has the nerve to break into song as if to mock Daichi. Even worse, her singing seems to make her Blading improve and she slams Strata Dragoon relentlessly. Kenny, a devoted fan of Ming Ming's, realizes that it's her voice that helps her concentrate on her blade and Tyson tells Daichi of her secret. Daichi uses his own voice to unleash the full power of Strata Dragoon but in the end Ming Ming proves to be the better blader and wins the match. Daichi is disappointed but being a good sportsman he congratulates Ming Ming. Tyson and the others realize that the Bega Bladers intend to fight fairly and they all vow to do their very best to win the next battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the second match of the Justice Five Battle and Ray and Crusher are facing off against each other. With Ming Ming's win against Daichi in the previous match, the BEGA League is already ahead by one so the pressure is on Ray to take the match. But Crusher is feeling the pressure too, not only for himself and his teammates but for his sister, Monica, who is undergoing surgery at the very same time. From the beginning, the battle is fierce with both Blader's inflicting significant damage. But Ray quickly gains the upper hand and it looks like its game over. It is only once Crusher calls upon the spirit of his brave, little sister that he is filled with the courage and strength necessary to match Ray. But with so much at stake, which Blader will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first two matches of the 'Justice 5' tournament are complete, and things aren't looking good for Tyson's squad, G Revolutions. BEGA's team is up two games to one in the best-of-five series. If they lose another match, BEGA will be victorious and have complete control over the sport of Beyblading. This puts a lot of pressure on Max to win game three against Mystel. Tyson and the others argue whether Max's signature defensive style will be enough to overcome Mystel's unpredictable and overpowering attack. Max takes this as a sign that his teammates only think he can win if he changes the way he Beyblades altogether. His confidence shattered, Max isolates himself and does some soul-searching. He receives a morale boost from a unlikely source ' Rick, his contentious PPB All Starz partner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three rounds already played, the G Revolutions team finds themselves with an unimpressive record' two matches lost, and one ending in a draw. Tyson and the rest of the team are practicing furiously to guarantee a check in the win column for tomorrow's big match. The bad news is, no one on the team has the same skill with the Hard Metal Beyblade as Tyson does' or at least that's what he thinks, and he refuses to choose any of his teammates to Blade in the last round of the tournament, insisting instead to blade both rounds himself. As all of the others vie for the last spot, Kai's frustration at his lack of control with his new Hard Metal Beyblade reaches an all-time high, combine that with his anger at what happened to Tala, and Kai's mood is even less cheery than usual. It isn't until he connects with an unlikely Blading opponent that he gains the technique he's been seeking for so long'the real question is, will Tyson and the rest of the gang welcome Kai back after all they've been through in the past?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the continuation of the Justice 5 Tournament with the BEGA Blader's leading the battle with two wins and a tie. If G Revolutions lose the next battle, they're out and BEGA (lead by the evil Boris) takes over the Beyblading Empire. The next battle is set to pit Tyson against Garland, but when the G Revolutions enter the stadium, they reveal their fifth team member- KAI!! Everyone is stunned, except for the BEGA Blader's who see him only as a loser. Kai is out for revenge because a few days earlier he lost a battle to Brooklyn. So, wanting to save face, Kai calls out Brooklyn, who arrogantly accepts his challenge. A massive battle ensues with Kai trying desperately to somehow attack his opponent, but nothing seems to work. And what's worse, Brooklyn seems to be copying Kai's every move. Kai becomes frustrated and realizes he must dig deep within himself to draw out more power. He does, however, it's making him weaker and weaker. The rest of the G Revolutions team wants him to quit. Kai refuses and in the end, he prepares for a final assault against his foe!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The battle of 'Justice 5 Tournament' continues and Kai is clearly overwhelmed by the power of Brooklyn of the Bega Bladers. Attack after attack sees Kai barely hanging on as he fights to stay in the match. Tyson and his team mates nervously watch, but vow to stay out of the battle because of a promise that Tyson made to Kai. Pleased with the progress of the battle and confident that Brooklyn will win, Boris watches from the sidelines with delight. Kai's determination to win against these unbeatable odds begins to frustrate Brooklyn and he increases the intensity of his attacks. Suddenly, when it seems that Kai can't take any more he manages to draw upon his Beyblading spirit and defeat Brooklyn. The crowd goes wild at this dramatic upset and Kai leaves the stadium only to collapse into Tyson's arms, battered and bruised. Brooklyn remains in the stadium, stunned and confused after suffering the first defeat of his Beyblading career. Kai assures his concerned team mates that he's all right and tells Tyson that he should be more concerned with his upcoming battle against Garland. Tyson, as confident as ever, shrugs Kai's advice off but secretly hopes he can summon the same amazing strength that his old friend showed in his battle. Kai walks unsteadily out of the stadium alone, collapses again, and then watches as Dranzer disintegrates in front of him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: All of G Revolutions hopes now rest on Tyson's match with Garland. Tyson is determined to make sure Kai's brave victory over Brooklyn isn't wasted. Garland is confident he will win. His family have been sports champions for centuries thanks to a book containing the Tzebult Principles of Victory. Those who follow the principles never lose! Tyson seeks the help of his friends to prepare, finding comfort and focus in their company. The match begins and Garland seems unbeatable due to the family principles. But Tyson isn't satisfied' he wants to fight the real Garland, not a book of rules. Tyson convinces Garland to abandon the family code and Beybattle like a true Blader. But can he withstand the full force of Garland unleashed?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Brooklyn has gone a little loopy after his loss against Kai. And the loss means either BEGA or the G Revolutions need one more victory to win the Justice 5 Tournament. To determine a winner, one battle is left and it will pit Tyson going up against one of the BEGA Blader's. But who will it be? Garland offers his services, but Hiro turns him down cold saying they need Brooklyn to fight this battle. Brooklyn's on the brink of a breakdown and now it's up to Hiro to get him back into fighting form.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match between the G Revolutions and the BEGA Bladers has arrived. Tyson prepares for the contest, unsure of whom he will ultimately face. It isn't until he steps onto the stadium floor when he discovers that he will go face to face, against Brooklyn himself. Brooklyn shows off his incredible powers immediately, stunning both teams on either side of the Beystadium. But no one has any idea of the true extent of Brooklyn's powers until he creates a wormhole to another dimension, creating an empty shell, carbon copy of the real world! The freak out continues as Brooklyn destroys everything in his new empty world to mold it into an image that makes him happy! Tyson has never faced an opponent like this! Does he stand a chance, or will BEGA continue its evil infection of the Beyblading community?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's mid-way through Tyson and Brooklyn's final tie-breaking 'Justice 5' match which could give BEGA a stranglehold on the entire sport of Beyblading. Having suffered his only previous defeat at the hands of Kai, Brooklyn's thirst for revenge takes the form of an unearthly power. Not only has his Beyblade Zeus given Brooklyn sinister black wings with which to fly, it's generated a giant vortex in the sky that is wreaking havoc on the city. Buildings are crumbling everywhere. The entire world is being enveloped by the growing darkness. Only Tyson can stop Brooklyn before it's too late. Summoning his own formidable power from Dragoon, Tyson flies into the sky to convince Brooklyn to cease the negative emotions that are causing the havoc. When reasoning fails, the pair continues their battle above the ever-crumbling city. The tide turns in Tyson's favor when he's able to summon the spirits of his teammates' blades and merge them with Dragoon, which evolves into the most powerful Beyblade ever. By probing deeper into Brooklyn's psyche, Tyson learns that his foe's anxiety stems from childhood isolation at being a genius so early in life. Tyson makes Brooklyn see that Beyblading is a pure sport to be enjoyed for one reason alone ' the love of the game. Brooklyn calms down. The chaos ends. And the pair continues their match simply for enjoyment. With BEGA's HQ in shambles, the upstart league and its owner Boris are ruined. Mr. Dickenson's BBA league restarts, but in a much more modest form. And kids everywhere ' including Tyson and his friends - return to the simple, purest form of Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Guardians of the Crescent Moon Kingdom [English Dub]
programme.desc: Naruto, Sakura, and Kakashi team up with Rock Lee to escort Prince Michiru and his son Hikaru, but a villainous uprising awaits their homecoming.

programme.title: BLEACH: The Movie - Memories of Nobody [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: An evil clan is sending the World of the Living and the Soul Society on a collision course. Can Ichigo and his fellow Soul Reapers save the two worlds from annihilation?

programme.title: BLEACH the Movie 2 : The DiamondDust Rebellion [English Dub]
programme.desc: After the treasured Ouin is stolen, Toshiro Hitsugaya disappears and becomes suspected of treason.

programme.title: BLEACH the Movie 3: Fade to Black [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ichigo must fight a lonely battle to save Rukia before the two are forced to part ways forever!

programme.title: BLEACH the Movie 4 : Hell Verse [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ichigo must travel into the depths of Hell to stop a group of vicious Sinners and save his younger sister Yuzu, unaware that his actions could bring Hell to the World of the Living.

programme.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tanjiro and Nezuko, along with Zenitsu and Inosuke, join one of the most powerful swordsmen within the Demon Slayer Corps, Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, to face the demon aboard the Mugen Train on track to despair.

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter: The Last Mission [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Battle Olympia begins! Gon and team attend, but The Shadow puts a deadly end to the festivities!

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter: Phantom Rouge [English Dub]
programme.desc: Someone has stolen Kurapika's eyes! Gon and Killua investigate, but the Phantom Troupe is back!

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow [English Dub]
programme.desc: Naruto and his team are sent on a mission to guard Yukie Fujikaze, a popular actress starring in the hit movie "The Adventures of Princess Gale."

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Legend of the Stone of Gelel [English Dub]
programme.desc: Drawn into a fierce struggle over the legendary Stone of Gelel, Naruto, Shikamaru, and Sakura must keep the stone from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Guardians of the Crescent Moon Kingdom [English Dub]
programme.desc: Naruto, Sakura, and Kakashi team up with Rock Lee to escort Prince Michiru and his son Hikaru, but a villainous uprising awaits their homecoming.

programme.title: BLEACH: The Movie - Memories of Nobody [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: An evil clan is sending the World of the Living and the Soul Society on a collision course. Can Ichigo and his fellow Soul Reapers save the two worlds from annihilation?

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ichiro Inuyashiki is a boring office worker who looks like an old man. Even after building them a new home, his family is nothing but ungrateful. He steps in to stop a group of kids from torturing a homeless man when he is knocked unconscious.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Reborn a robot, Inuyashiki finds meaning by saving others. Meanwhile, high school student Hiro Shishigami has also been reborn a robot. Contrary to Inuyashiki, he feels alive when he is taking the lives of others. What happens when these two meet?

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: It seems the notorious Kid the Phantom Thief has returned after eight years. At first, high school student and master illusionist Kaito seeks to challenge the magic trick-wielding outlaw out of pride, but then he learns that his deceased father was actually Kid the Phantom Thief, so who is the newcomer? Kaito puts on his dad's old cape, hat, and monocle and takes to the air to get answers.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito finds himself double-booked when a theft he announced beforehand is on the same night as Aoko's birthday party. Complicating matters is the appearance of a group of jewel-collecting thugs who may have had something to do with the murder of Kaito's father.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito goes up against a Syndicate-owned pool hall hustler to win back the Legendary Cue, a treasure once owned by Jii before he was cheated it out of it by the Syndicate boss many years ago. However, things look dire when Jii's pool hall is put on the line and Kaito apparently has no skill with the game.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: The top of Ishiyama duke it out with the 6 Holy Knights on the roof! Miki explains how he looked up to Oga back in middle school, and now wants to prove that he's surpassed him with his powerful punching, but before they can settle things the final 2 of the 6 Holy Knights show up, and call off the battle. The next day, Oga and the gang are all set to be expelled!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: The sport for Ishiyama's showdown with the 6 Holy Knights has been decided... It's volleyball! Kunieda is all ready to start practice when a mysterious transfer student arrives... Actually, it's Hilda, who for some reason has decided to get involved... But can she find a way to actually get the guys motivated to practice?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga gets tired of volleyball practice and stumbles upon Miki practicing his special move in a dojo. Miki and Oga decided to "spar" with each other, and Miki asks Oga why he betrayed him in the past... Finally, the truth behind Miki's thirst for beating Oga will be revealed!

programme.desc: Trouble is all but guaranteed when a crime boss and an arms merchant join hands. The two set their eyes on Goemen's sword, which can split a tank in half! After hiring Fujiko to steal it, they transform the sword into an invincible flying weapon of war.

They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito goes up against a Syndicate-owned pool hall hustler to win back the Legendary Cue, a treasure once owned by Jii before he was cheated it out of it by the Syndicate boss many years ago. However, things look dire when Jii's pool hall is put on the line and Kaito apparently has no skill with the game.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A brilliant if arrogant teen detective comes to town, determined to capture Kid the Phantom Thief. This turns the heat up for Kaito, especially since they're classmates. In fact, Kaito becomes Suguru's rival even out of uniform, leading to a "gentlemen's bet" over which of them will go on a date with Aoko.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito has a new classmate, Akako, who appears to possess genuine magic abilities, the kind that bend everyone to her will... except for Kaito and his alter ego, Kid the Phantom Thief! Who will come out on top in the inevitable showdown, sorceress or illusionist?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: It's finally the day of the Saint Ishiyama School Festival and the big volleyball match! But the match doesn't happen until the afternoon, so Furuichi decides to enjoy the school festival atmosphere, specifically the Maid Cafe that Azusa and her class are running. Unfortunately things get a bit out of hand...

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: The match between Ishiyama and the 6 Holy Knights is here, and this is not your usual volleyball! With their pride and their educational future on the line, the Ishiyama gang puts it all out there on the court! Will Furuichi the Strategist be their trump card?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Don Kecchi, the wealthiest man in America, is terminally ill and has announced that he's donating his entire fortune to charity. However, Lupin steals Kecchi's money and shoots Fujiko right in front of Inspector Zenigata!

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Marguerite Tiffany, the owner of Tiffany's and a TV anchor, hires Lupin and his gang to rob her jewelry store on live TV. Initially, Lupin refuses, but ends up having to go through with it thanks to Fujiko's wild spending habits.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Elrics meet Shou Tucker, a leading researcher in the field of chimeras. He has much to teach Ed and Al about alchemy - and the horrible cruelty that sometimes accompanies it.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Edward and Alphonse are attacked by Scar, a mysterious killer wanted for a string of gruesome murders. His powers are incredible - and his obsession with slaying State Alchemists might be justified.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Before arriving at the Rockbell home for repairs, the Elrics meet Dr. Marcoh, a State Alchemist running from past sins. The information he gives Ed and Al could put the Philosopher's Stone within reach.

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Legend of the Stone of Gelel [English Dub]
programme.desc: Drawn into a fierce struggle over the legendary Stone of Gelel, Naruto, Shikamaru, and Sakura must keep the stone from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Chris' mother Lindsey is shooting a movie in an old castle and Sonic and his friends are there to visit as well. However, they begin to notice that something is amiss as ghostly figures begin to appear.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Sonic and his friends are on a cruise when the Egg Fort appears inside a glacier. As Sonic faces his foes, he receives some help from Knuckles.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Sam Speed challenges Sonic to a race on his new racing car. After much plodding, Sonic accepts the challenge but Eggman decides to interrupt the whole ordeal with his newly invented robot "Sumo-Man".

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. Seeing that, Inuyashiki knows that Shishigami has a robot body just like himself. After this meeting, Inuyashiki studies his abilities, and uses them to save others. Meanwhile, Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his best friend Naoyuki Ando.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: When the fully tattooed yakuza criminal Samejima finds a girl he likes, he kidnaps them, drugs them up, and then roughs them up. Fumino was happy. She had a job and a fiance. But one night, Samejima sets his sights on her, and has his men kidnap her. Fumino manages to escape, and runs to her fiance Satoru's house, but Samejima is in hot pursuit. Inuyashiki comes to save them, but gets shot.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ando is struggling with the fact that his friend Shishigami is responsible for the spree of home invasions. After reading that hospital patients were being cured, Ando theorizes that there is someone else out there with the same powers as Shishigami. Ando lures Inuyashiki by pretending to need help and asks him to stop Shishigami. Meanwhile, Shishigami learns his mother has terminal cancer.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los integrantes del grupo tienen entrevistas con Deanna, la jefa de Alejandría, y esperan en las casas que les asignan a saber si son aceptados o rechazados. Cuando conocen a los habitantes de la comunidad, perciben que no están bien entrenados.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick, Daryl y Carol se reúnen en secreto para planear cómo recuperar sus armas del arsenal de Alexandria, ya que temen que, si algo sale mal, van a necesitarlas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol le sugiere a Rick que deben asesinar a Pete porque es violento con su esposa e hijo. Por otra parte, Gabriel advierte a Deanna que desconfíe del grupo de Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Deanna y Rick se culpan mutuamente de las muertes de Aidenn y Noah. Rick le ofrece a Jessie protección ante Pete, pero este lo descubre y se enzarza en una pelea con él. La tensión en Alexandria aumenta y algo terrible se avecina.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Deanna quiere expulsar al grupo de Rick de Alejandría y ellos se preparan para defenderse. Sin embargo, la llegada de una banda de asaltantes y la irrupción de una horda de zombis interrumpen el enfrentamiento entre los dos bandos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick y Morgan encuentran una horda descomunal de zombis en una cantera cercana a Alejandría. Entretanto, Carter convoca a varios habitantes de Alejandría para proponerles un plan: matar a Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los Lobos, el grupo con el que ya habían combatido, asalta Alejandría y empieza a acuchillar a sus ciudadanos por las calles. Durante la pelea, Enid huye de Alejandría y Ron rechaza la ayuda de Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo trata de reconducir a la horda de zombis para alejarla de Alejandría, pero el plan falla y Glenn y Nicholas terminan rodeados por muertos vivientes. Rick, por su parte, es atacado por los asaltantes que Morgan expulsó de Alejandría.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Morgan le explica a un asaltante al que mantiene cautivo cómo venció a la ira que le consumía y aprendió que el camino correcto es aquel que rechaza la violencia.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick regresa a Alejandría, donde el ánimo está decaído por la presencia de la horda de zombis y las secuelas del asalto sufrido. Maggie y Aarón salen en busca de Glenn. Denise pierde la confianza en sí misma, pero Tara la anima.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl se separa de Abraham y Sasha mientras regresan a Alejandría. Un trío de fugitivos captura a Daryl, aunque él trata de convencerlos de que se unan a su comunidad.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Glenn encuentra a Enid y la convence de regresar junto a él a Alexandria. Mientras, en la comunidad, Ron roba armas del arsenal y Carol se enfrenta a Morgan porque no confía en él.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La horda de zombis invade Alejandría a través de la grieta que se produjo en el muro. Rick, Michonne, Carl, Gabriel y Deanna se ocultan en la casa de Jessie, pero se dan cuenta de que están rodeados.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Ahora que los caminantes han traspasado las barreras de Alejandría, Rick y los otros sobrevivientes deben seguir luchando para mantenerse a salvo e intentar no perder la esperanza.

programme.desc: El grupo de Rick acompaña a Jesús a su comunidad, La Cumbre. Allí, un residente intenta matar a Gregory, el líder, por órdenes de Negan. Maggie hace un pacto con Gregory: matarán a Negan a cambio de la mitad de las provisiones que guardan.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo se prepara para su más feroz batalla y los caminos de Rick y Morgan se alejan. Mientras tanto, el pasado de Carol regresa para acecharla.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras haber obtenido un éxito menor, algunos de los miembros del grupo han sido hechos prisioneros por sus nuevos enemigos y el resto de los supervivientes de Alejandría tendrá que tratar de liberarlos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Abraham abandona a Eugene durante una misión porque él le dice que no necesita su protección. Daryl, Rosita y Denise se topan con un grupo de los Salvadores, dirigidos por Dwight, y entre los dos bandos se produce un tiroteo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol desaparece de Alejandría y toda la comunidad se coordina para localizarla. Sin embargo, lo que algunos de ellos encuentran no es lo que andaban buscando.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Para salvar a Maggie, que se encuentra enferma, el grupo de Rick se aventura fuera de los muros de Alejandría. Pero los hombres de Negan los están esperando en la carretera.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick Grimes, policía de una pequeña localidad de Georgia, despierta de un coma y repentinamente se encuentra en un mundo apocalíptico. Desorientado, en busca de su familia y una explicación a lo acontecido, Rick ha de adaptarse al nuevo orden.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick llega a caballo a Atlanta, donde encuentra una ciudad desolada. Tras escapar de una situación de peligro, Rick se une a un grupo de supervivientes en unos grandes almacenes, donde le espera un enemigo más peligroso que los zombis.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick regresa a Atlanta al sentirse culpable de haber dejado a Merle abandonado en un edificio asolado por zombis. En el campamento, la inesperada llegada de Rick causa tensión entre Lori y Shane, quien había asegurado que Rick había muerto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En Atlanta, una banda armada sorprende al grupo de Rick mientras están buscando a Merle. Entretanto, en el campamento, Jim empieza a comportarse de forma extraña, tiene premoniciones y asusta a los niños con una tragedia que se aproxima.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras el ataque al campamento, Rick conduce al grupo hacia el CDC, un recinto de la base sanitaria militar, en el que esperan encontrar un refugio seguro. Durante el trayecto, Jim debe tomar una decisión extremadamente difícil.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Un científico inquietante deja entrar a Rick y su grupo en el CDC. No obstante, hay algo extraño y los supervivientes del apocalipsis zombi empiezan a sospechar que no todo es lo que parece en el recinto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo, liderado por Rick, se topa con una horda de zombis en mitad de la autopista. La pequeña Sophia, asustada, huye sola al bosque y todos tratarán de encontrarla antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick encuentra una granja en la que buscar ayuda para salvar la vida de su hijo, quien recibió el impacto accidental de una bala. Después, Shane entra en una escuela llena de zombis para llevarse material sanitario junto al tipo que disparó a Carl.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Shane y Otis están atrapados por los zombis en la escuela adonde acudieron por el material sanitario necesario para operar a Carl. En la granja, surgen las primeras tensiones y Daryl y Andrea vuelven a salir en busca de Sophie.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Shane regresa a la granja con las medicinas, pero el sacrificio que ha tenido que cometer no es bien visto por el resto del grupo. En la granja, el grupo intenta sacar a un zombi del pozo de agua fresca antes de que la infecte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras busca a Sophia, Daryl sufre un accidente que lo deja perdido y herido en el bosque. La tensión entre el grupo y los propietarios de la granja aumenta, así como la inestabilidad del propio grupo, debido a que Shane desafía a Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras descubrir que la familia mantiene encerrada a sus familiares convertidos en zombis en el granero, Dale confronta a Hershel. Lori, por su parte, confiesa a Rick que está embarazada y los problemas entre los integrantes del grupo se intensifican.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Glenn le revela a todo el grupo el secreto del granero, pero no están de acuerdo sobre cómo actuar: Rick ordena respetar la autoridad de Hershel, aunque Shane quiere acabar con los zombis. Por otra parte, descubren por fin qué le ha pasado a Sophia.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Hershel no soporta lo ocurrido y recae en su alcoholismo, pero Rick y Glenn lo siguen hasta la ciudad para evitar que muera. Entretanto, Beth, incapaz de aceptar todo lo que le está sucediendo a su familia, entra en estado catatónico.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Lori sale en busca de Rick, pero lo único que encuentra es un peligro mortal y Shane va tras ella. Entretanto, Rick, Hershel y Glenn mantienen un tiroteo con los desconocidos con quienes cruzaron sus caminos en el bar.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La tensión entre Rick y Shane aumenta y la decisión sobre el destino de Randall es el detonante: Shane quiere matarlo, Rick prefiere dejarlo vivo. Mientras, Beth pretende suicidarse y Andrea, quien debe vigilarla, no cumple con su cometido.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo descubre que Randall es un violador y asesino y acuerdan ejecutarlo, pero Dale se opone porque eso los convertiría también en criminales. Mientras tanto, Carl comete un error que acarreará consecuencias imprevistas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Las diferencias entre Rick y Shane por el liderato del grupo y la gestión de la granja se intensifican cuando Shane decide por su cuenta el destino de Randall. La tensión termina estallando y los dos amigos se enfrentan a muerte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Una horda de zombis invade la granja y el grupo intenta escapar vivo entre el caos, pero no todos lo lograrán. Además, Rick se harta de las quejas del grupo y les da un ultimátum: si quieren que sea el líder, acatarán sus órdenes.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo encuentra refugio en las instalaciones de una prisión federal abandonada tras meses en la carretera. Rick considera que se trata de un lugar seguro para que Lori pase los últimos meses de embarazo, pero quizá se haya equivocado.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick accede a dejar salir de sus celdas a los prisioneros si les ayudan a matar a los zombis que quedan en la prisión. Entretanto, la salud de Hershel empeora por momentos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Andrea y Michonne descubren una comunidad de sobrevivientes liderada por un hombre llamado el Gobernador. Allá les ofrecen medicinas, comida, agua caliente y ropa limpia, pero Michonne desconfía del Gobernador y sus verdaderas intenciones.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En Woodbury, Michonne desconfía del Gobernador y planea irse sin Andrea. En la prisión, un sabotaje provoca que una horda de zombis penetre en la cárcel y, mientras Rick y sus compañeros los combaten, Lori entra en trabajo de parto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick está totalmente abatido por la muerte de Lori, pero recibe una llamada telefónica sorprendente. Entretanto, Michonne ha descubierto el secreto del Gobernador y se dispone a abandonar Woodbury, a pesar de que Andrea quiere permanecer allá.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Michonne ve a Glenn y Maggie buscando provisiones, pero alguien más los observa: Merle, quien reconoce a Glenn como uno de los que le abandonó, a merced de los zombis, en una azotea de Atlanta. Entretanto, Rick sigue mentalmente inestable.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Michonne conduce a Rick, Daryl y Oscar a Woodbury para rescatar a Glenn y Maggie, a quienes el Gobernador está torturando para sonsacarles dónde se oculta el grupo de Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo de Rick invade Woodbury con la intención de rescatar a Glenn y Maggie. Michonne descubre el secreto familiar que oculta el Gobernador cuando trata de asesinarlo. En la prisión, un grupo desconocido atraviesa la verja de seguridad.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick y Maggie regresan a Woodbury para salvar a Daryl, quien está obligado a luchar contra su hermano. Entretanto, en la prisión, el grupo de Rick se encuentra con el grupo de Sasha y Tyreese.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En secreto, el Gobernador y sus hombres preparan una incursión mortal contra la prisión. Darryl y Merle llegan en mitad de la contienda.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El Gobernador permite a Andrea, acompañada de Milton, ir a la prisión a negociar la paz con su antiguo grupo. Mientras, Tyreese y Sasha llegan a Woodbury y le ofrecen al Gobernador información sobre la prisión a cambio de poder quedarse allá.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick, Michonne y Carl viajan al condado de Rick en busca de armamento y encuentran a alguien a quien creían muerto. Durante la misión, Rick cambia la percepción que tiene de Michonne.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Andrea concierta un encuentro entre Rick y el Gobernador para que negocien la paz, pero el Gobernador exige la cabeza de Michonne a cambio del alto el fuego.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Andrea descubre la verdad sobre el Gobernador e intenta huir para alertar al grupo de Rick, pero el Gobernador envía a sus hombres en su busca. Entretanto, alguien ha provocado un sabotaje en Woodbury y los sospechosos son Tyreese y Milton.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick duda entre entregarle o no a Michonne al Gobernador y poner así fin a la contienda. Sin embargo, Merle se anticipa a las órdenes de Rick y decide tomar una decisión por su propia cuenta.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El Gobernador y sus hombres lanzan un ataque contra la prisión, pero el grupo de Rick se defiende. Al final de la contienda, solo una de las dos comunidades podrá seguir existiendo.

programme.desc: Alicia pide terapia para su esposa Andrea, ella practica una extraña y peligrosa danza japonesa. Carlos quiere desalojar a Lázaro, él lo mandó a prisión y se quedó con su casa y con su hermana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paula es adicta a la crema de mentol y la usa en todo su cuerpo, pero la crema le causó daño a su esposo y ahora él la demanda. Fabiola se convirtió al cristianismo y por eso le pide el divorcio a su pareja.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por haberle transmitido sida, Sara le pide 500 mil dólares a Geovanny y la lista de las personas con las que ha tenido sexo. Claudia lo ataca con un machete, él la demanda por 50 mil dólares.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Viviana descubrió que su padre está muerto y no la abandonó como su madre dijo. También se dio cuenta de que esta ya se gastó toda la herencia que dejó el difunto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diana dice que su esposo cambió cuando la vio parir, ella cree que él es gay. Ahora pide la custodia de su hija y 25 mil dólares. Cynthia despide a César por fumar marihuana, él pide ser indemnizado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sebastián desea emanciparse de su mamá Andrea, quien vive con un sicario involucrado en el crimen de su padre. Carlos planea ir a Puerto Rico a vengar la muerte de su amigo, pero su esposa se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paulina averiguó que su esposo toma fotos de los hombres en los baños públicos, por lo que desea separarse. Danilo supo por Facebook que tiene un hijo y trata de detener el proceso para darlo en adopción.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alonso pretende la custodia de una de las hijas mellizas de Antonio y Mariana. Sofía requiere que Michelle desaloje su casa porque se ha hecho adicta a olfatear los condones con semen.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Renata estaba embarazada de gemelos con un donante de esperma, pero uno de los bebés nació muerto y ahora se pelean por el otro. Rolando teme que su sobrina mate a su madre, por eso pide que se vaya.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Maritza se entera de que su novia tuvo sexo con 364 hombres, por eso la demanda y cancela la boda. La mujer de Luis quiere el divorcio porque por culpa de él casi se electrocuta su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carlos pide una orden de alejamiento contra su esposa, quien mantiene una papa en la vagina. Juan solicita la custodia de su hijo porque su pareja es satanista y teme por su salud física y mental.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Karla quedó embarazada de su padrastro, al parir le dejó el bebé a su madre y ahora ella no se lo quiere devolver. Pilar le exige a Tania desalojar la casa que le alquiló antes de que la destruya.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una niña de 14 años tiene la vagina deformada; insatisfecha, quiere autorización para operársela y lucir mejor. Una madre no deja que su hijo autista ayude a niños con cáncer; Ignacio la amenaza.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Johnny fue despedido por no complacer el acoso sexual de su jefa; ahora exige una compensación. Ignacio golpeó a su esposa, lo grabaron y publicaron el video; él demanda a quien lo hizo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Helen se niega a darle la residencia en EE. UU. a su hija; el papá de la niña, Felipe, la demanda para obligarla. América pide emanciparse porque descubrió que su madrastra es la amante de su hermano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una artista dona su cadáver para exponerlo en una galería de arte, pero su marido Luciano intenta impedirlo. Luis quiere quitarle la custodia de su hermana con síndrome de Down a su enfermera Libia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marian exige que Gary interne a su hermana, pero él alega que Emily solo necesita unión familiar. A Karla le traumatizaba el tráfico, quiso cambiar de horario y fue despedida; ahora exige una compensación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un mago quiere desalojar a su aprendiz por revelar muchos trucos. Una adolescente está embarazada, pero tiene cáncer. Sus padres debaten si salvar la vida del futuro bebé o la de su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paulina enviudó y se casó con Franco. Pero el esposo de Paulina reapareció y ahora Franco los demanda. Federico es minusválido y sufre de erecciones. Elizabeth se aprovechó y se embarazó, pero ahora Federico reclama al bebé.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Raquel necesita ser parte de la vida de su hijo con Roberto, pero este dice que no porque el niño es producto de un incesto. Tania es una ex luchadora que quiere volver al ring, pero su hijo se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un hombre le da educación sexual a dos niñas con vegetales; una madre lo denuncia. La esposa de una de las víctimas de un juego mortal demanda al agresor de su marido por 50 mil dólares.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: David subió un video en Facebook donde dice que va a matar a su amiga; piden una orden de alejamiento. Camilo quiere sacar a su mujer de la casa y quedarse con la sirvienta que se ganó la lotería.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María le exige a su marido que desaloje a su hermano por ser un depredador sexual, ella teme por su niña. Un padre acusa a la madre de su hijo de ser drogadicta y pide la patria potestad.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Camilo usa cocaína como remedio para su eyaculación precoz; la esposa denuncia que la drogó. Un padre quiere comprar un riñón en Irán para su hija, pero la madre demanda que se lo prohíban.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Melba está preso en Colombia por defender a su novia; la mamá pide que ella lo ayude. Mario quiere quitarle su hija a Elly, alega que ella la contamina con odio hacia los hombres.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un hombre planea convertir a su esposa en "la reina del toilet". Elizabeth, su suegra, pide una orden de alejamiento. Iván se inyecta un medicamento en el pene para más potencia; su esposa quiere el divorcio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La Pitonisa exige una orden de alejamiento por agresión contra la cantante Nati. Pedro quiere divorciarse de Ana, quien alega ser asexual. Pedro asegura que ella lo rechaza porque le falta una pierna.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nathaniel le exige a Medi que le devuelva la custodia de su sobrino. Carla le dona un riñón al hombre que ama a cambio de que le quite su virginidad. Ahora la esposa demanda a la donante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: John exige la custodia de la hija que su hermano, preso, tuvo con Franchesca, quien sufre leucemia. Daniela solicita extender la orden de alejamiento para Hamed porque la agredió varias veces.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nataly va a que le predigan el futuro a través de sus nalgas; su esposo no lo tolera y solicita la custodia del niño que tienen en común. Jorge se llevó a Evelyn a su casa, pero ahora pide su desalojo; ella quiere una compensación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Eduardo, musulmán, fue despedido por defender a los terroristas de ISIS. Ahora solicita 100 mil dólares de indemnización. Carol teme que Ana se suicide y exige que la internen en un psiquiátrico.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Leopoldo demanda una orden de alejamiento para Paula, su exnovia, porque lo acosa. Karla espera incapacitar a su mamá, quien es diabética y va a donarle un riñón a su novio menor que ella.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yuri quiere que alejen a Ana de su abuela de 87 años porque la induce a fumar marihuana. La bailarina Lina intenta anular un contrato con Felipe, ya que él pretende que ella baile desnuda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Edgar es antichavista y no acepta que su exmujer se lleve a su hija a Venezuela con su nuevo esposo chavista. Shariz le exige a Hilda que busque ayuda para su hermana de crianza, Nayla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lázaro le hizo una promesa a San Lázaro y ahora se viste como el santo, por eso Luisa se va a divorciar. Martín tiene una enfermedad terminal y piensa quitarse la vida; su madre pide que lo salven.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mónica exige anular un contrato que firmó con Ricardo, su ex yerno, y con su hija. Mónica se prestó para ser madre subrogada, pero ahora su hija y su yerno se separaron y Mónica quiere abortar a la criatura.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Juan nació sin miembro viril. Aunque pudo casarse, quiere injertarse un pene. Cristina exige una indemnización por la muerte de su esposo, quien murió a causa de un gusano que se come la piel.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un niño que se siente mujer desde su nacimiento decidió tomar hormonas femeninas para iniciar su cambio de sexo. Magdalena fue abandonada por su mamá y demanda 18 mil dólares de manutención.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alondra exige terapia psicológica para su esposo Luis, quien está obsesionado con una famosa llamada Vampy. María pide que su madre le permita hablar con su padre, a quien daba por muerto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristina le exige 10 mil dólares a su esposo, Alejandro, por abuso sexual. Saúl intenta obligar a Alejandra a que le permita usar sus ahorros para que su suegra tenga una muerte asistida.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniela le dio a Juan un helado de viagra que lo volvió un pervertido; ahora él la demanda por 25 mil dólares. Teixeira exige que la amante de su esposo le dé las propiedades y joyas que él le regaló.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jorge y su amante quedaron enganchados como dos perritos y tuvieron que llamar a emergencias. Carmen se niega a devolverle la custodia de su hija a Aurora, alega que no está preparada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gabriela fue arrestada, humillada y despedida de su empleo porque Ricardo dio información personal sin permiso de ella. Un niño murió atropellado por su tío. La tragedia pesa sobre la familia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Doris exige que le devuelvan la custodia de sus hijas; Carlos alega que ella tiene que curarse primero. Todos los beneficios de la esposa militar de Mariana se los dieron al exmarido.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una mujer utiliza la imagen de su hija como si la niña estuviera en huelga de hambre. En su testamento, un anciano aseguró que quien lo mate durante el sexo heredará todos sus bienes.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Natasha denuncia que Gabriel quiere convertir a su hijo pequeño en drag queen. Carmen exige congelar una cuenta de ahorros que le abrió a su hijo; él le quiere dar un uso distinto al dinero.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Manuel va a salir de la cárcel y él quiere desalojar a su nuera y quedarse con la custodia de su nieto. Un matrimonio está en crisis porque un cónyuge perdonó al asesino de su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis es el dueño de una sala de banquetes en donde Estefanie fue grabada en secreto mientras estaba en el baño. A un bebé que nació con serios problemas médicos le dan poco tiempo de vida.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mientras practicaba juegos sexuales, a Santiago le introdujeron un teléfono celular en el recto. Ariel fue a la cárcel y le quitaron a su hijo; ahora que está libre lo quiere de regreso.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mariana y Eduardo siempre quisieron ser padres, pero desde que ella quedó embarazada, se obsesionó con encontrar al donante de semen. Lilian exige ir a vivir con su madre a Puerto Rico, pero su padre no lo permite.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sarah fue violada y torturada por abandonar el islam y convertirse al cristianismo. Camila está decepcionada de vivir en los Estados Unidos, quiere divorciarse y llevarse a su hija a Venezuela.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sofía no puede permitir que la chica que fue su mejor amiga sea ahora la esposa de su padre. Marlon exige el divorcio de Salma y la custodia de su hijo. Salma no quiere divorciarse.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mary adoptó al hijo de Mónica sin su consentimiento. Fernanda recibió 100 mil dólares cuando tenía 15 años; ahora, con 21, descubre que su madre y su hermano se han gastado casi todo el dinero.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vino de Venezuela con su esposo y compraron una propiedad; a sus espaldas, él se casó con otra mujer y la metió a vivir en su casa. Cada vez que se enfurece, Orlando abusa físicamente de Eddie.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La melodía del serrucho vuelve loca a Maritza. Su marido le pide tratamiento psicológico. Gustavo exige la custodia de su sobrina sordomuda y que la madre de la pequeña desaloje la casa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su nieta tiene un novio que mantiene una relación con otro hombre y a su madre le parece bien. Una mujer padece el síndrome del acaparador compulsivo y en su casa no se puede vivir.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un padre le da hierbas a su hija de ocho años porque la vio tocarse, la madre está preocupada por la seguridad de su hija. Fátima es una cartera que fue despedida por estar embarazada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por culpa de su marido, Ana perdió una pierna y a sus hijos; ahora pide el divorcio y la custodia de sus hijas. Alexis exige que Jorge se haga cargo de su mamá, la señora que trafica drogas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nelson todavía sufre por las amenazas que recibió en Colombia. Carlos exige una orden de alejamiento para Ximena, quien quiere recuperar a su hija a pesar de que continúa metida en drogas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nachi y Enrique son hermanos, conviven con una mujer y los dos están enamorados de ella. Javier exige que Carmen, la pareja de su padre, pague la deuda que dejó su progenitor antes de morir.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Liliana pagó 100 000 dólares por el rescate de Daniela, pero está convencida de que su hermana planificó el secuestro para estafarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Natasha exige la custodia de su hijo, Brend alega que la ama y que quiere seguir con ella. Un difunto le dejó la herencia a su exmujer, pero su actual esposa tiene un poder para quedarse con todo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Stephanie vino a vivir con su padre y quiere regresar a Venezuela porque él es alcohólico, vive en un tráiler y no se ocupa de ella. Además, tres hermanos se pelean por la herencia de su padre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Joaquín se lesionó cuando jugaba en el equipo de fútbol de su empresa. El dueño se niega a pagarle el sueldo mientras se recupera. José exige que el padre de su nieto se haga cargo del menor.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Claudia recibió una golpiza de una mujer que contrató Ignacio y exige que él le pague 200 000 dólares por daños y perjuicios. Una adolescente rebelde no quiere más castigos corporales de su padre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Liliana tiene un problema grave: su marido prefiere a su perra, hasta en la cama. Jean es un adolescente desesperado, su padre alcohólico lo desprecia, su única posibilidad es un tío tiránico.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis tuvo una relación extramatrimonial y fue contagiado con una enfermedad venérea que le causó el divorcio. Lilian renta un cuarto a jóvenes, los seduce y los acusa de intento de violación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sara es modelo profesional y durante una sesión de fotos le destrozaron una nalga con un palo de golf. Vanessa es una travesti que se ha encariñado con un niño y ahora no lo quiere entregar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una madre busca obligar a su hija a que filme películas pornográficas con ella. Un joven diabético está enamorado de una chica menor de edad, ella quiere casarse con él, pero su madre lo prohíbe.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un viudo se excita con las cenizas de su difunta esposa para tener relaciones sexuales con su actual mujer. Victoria exige el divorcio a Roberto, quien es mago y desaparece el dinero que gana.

programme.title: Border Blues
programme.desc: A dangerous smuggler helps an attractive woman and her 5-year-old daughter, while a police chief pursues a mad bomber in Los Angeles. Starring Eric Roberts, Gary Busey, Rodion Nahapetov

programme.title: Brain Dead
programme.desc: The story of six people caught in the unusual (except in horror films) predicament of being stranded in a deserted fishing lodge with a host of alien-infected, mutant amoeba-controlled zombies at their doorstep.

programme.title: Blood and Steel: Cedar Crest Country Club
programme.desc: The story of an 80’s skateboarding mecca, tucked in the woods of a country club, that drew some of the best up-and-coming skaters and punk bands from across the country. From the mouths of the rebels who lived it, hear how one ramp became a legend. - Starring Tony Hawke, Ian MacKaye, Bucky Lasek

programme.title: Captain Orellana and the Possessed Village
programme.desc: Captain Orellana, a former police investigator has been tapped for the wackiest, most dangerous case of his long career. He’s hired to examine the strange occurrences in a remote village in which many of the villages seem to be … POSSESSED! With 007-like swagger Orellana takes on the challenge.

programme.title: Charlotte
programme.desc: A teenage girl is baby sitting at a new house when she's accosted by a vicious, possessed doll. With the baby sitter in bondage, the toy subjects her to a series of terrifying tales on the television, each story more twisted than the last.

programme.title: Brackenmore
programme.desc: Upon news of her uncle's death, Kate must return to her family home in the tiny rural village of Brackenmore, where the eccentric, wary residents are hiding a dark secret that entangles Kate in a dangerous, cultish design.

programme.title: Life Tastes Good
programme.desc: A quirky tale that brings together a murder, poison mushrooms and a mysterious woman to reveal the ephemeral beauty of life and the unforgiving nature of death.

programme.title: Kessler's Lab
programme.desc: When a secret drug trial using human clones must come to an end, a conflicted psychologist risks everything to stop a deranged doctor and save the clones before it's too late.

programme.title: Love Meet Hope
programme.desc: A grandfather's love stories enlighten a jaded man and a moonstruck girl about the realities of love. Starring Amanda Markowitz, Bradley Fowler, Ed Asner

programme.title: Magic Boys
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, a hapless pair of misfits escape their own near death experience by posing as male strippers - only to find themselves neck deep in even bigger trouble. Starring Vinnie Jones, Michael Madsen, Tamer Hassan

programme.title: Keeping Rosy
programme.desc: A taut, exciting thriller about a woman who accidentally kills and desperately plots to cover up her crime.

programme.title: Leave
programme.desc: Henry Harper is a successful novelist who has it all. But after surviving a recent trauma he finds himself haunted by a dream that terrifies him. Convinced that the only way to understand what the dream means is to write his way through it. Starring Rick Gomez, Frank John Hughes, Vinessa Shaw

programme.title: Mary Loss of Soul
programme.desc: Mary's soul has been ripped from her body. She returns after disappearing without any memory of the traumatic events she experienced. Meanwhile a wrathful spirit haunts her family, leaving them no choice but to find her soul before time runs out.

programme.title: Les Formidables
programme.desc: Inspector Sung-woo gets lambasted at work when his partner gets killed during a routine stakeout. Knowing he’s doomed, Su-hyun escapes right under the nose of massive security. In the process, he kidnaps the hapless Sung-woo, leading to the most outlandish test of wills and survival. Starring Joong-Hoon Park, Jeong-myeong Cheon, In-yeong Yu

programme.title: Love Simple
programme.desc: Adam and Seta fall in love in a Brooklyn laundromat, but they’ve each got a secret and it’s a full-time job to keep they’re lies straight.

programme.title: Jaguar
programme.desc: A young archaeologist has 24 hours in Mexico City to find a Mayan jaguar relic that's been missing for 600 years in exchange for her husband's life.

programme.title: Jakes Corner
programme.desc: The fictional story of an ex-football star, Johnny Dunn, who moves far from the spotlight after a family tragedy to a small, desert town he owns called Jake's Corner. Starring Colton Rodgers, Richard Tyson, Danny Trejo

programme.title: Holy Hustle
programme.desc: Cain McGee finds himself alone after the death of his mother and untimely break-up with his girlfriend. Things go bad to worse when his often invisible, con man brother who only return home to get his hands on his portion of the inheritance--or so he thinks.

programme.title: Edible Nutmeg: On the Road
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Plum hits the road with Edible Nutmeg, visiting Litchfield's newest homegrown distillery. Drinks are shared and gin chicken wings are on the grill for this summer-ready exploration of local food and drink!

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode of Authentic Escapes, Sandra McLemore takes families on a journey where history and adventure come together in unforgettable ways. From navigating the hedge maze at Vienna’s Schönbrunn Palace—once a playground for royalty—to wandering the lavish halls of Cairo’s Abdeen Palace, this trip is anything but ordinary. In Aswan, families pause for an elegant high tea at the Old Cataract Hotel, the very place where Agatha Christie wrote Death on the Nile. It’s a moment of calm and connection, with sweeping Nile views and Egyptian charm. The journey wraps in Prague, where a vintage Alfa Romeo transforms a sightseeing tour into a glamorous ride through history. More than just sightseeing, Family Travel celebrates curiosity, culture, and time spent together. Whether you're sipping tea or solving a maze, these experiences spark conversations—and memories—that last long after the trip is over.

programme.title: Follow Me To Taiwan
programme.desc: Selfie sticks at the ready! Join TaiwanPlus on a tour of Taiwan’s best tourist spots.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!
